title: Volcanoes of Ecuador
intro: 10 volcanoes of Ecuador, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. The map shows coasts, rivers, lakes and borders, and you work inside this area.

rounds.name: Guagua Pichincha
rounds.fact: Guagua Pichincha is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 1999. The data places it in Ecuador.

rounds.name: Altar
rounds.fact: Altar is a stratovolcano with a recorded summit elevation of 5,321 m in the source data. The data places it in Ecuador.
